title: American Airlines: Sydney to New York $1019, Chicago $1019, Houston $1017, Denver $1017, LA $1019 Return - Oct to Jun @ BTF
body:

[MrZ] I recently found out that song is from 1977, having always assumed it was much older (it sounds like it's from the 50s).
[Zeee] Just paid $2700 for qatar these too cheap
[willyroo] Having gone through LAX about 3 weeks ago, I hear ya. What a horrible place, you're made to feel like a criminal for having the gall to want to visit.
[surg3on] But you might want to stay permanently in their shitty country! (that has amazing natural wonders)

Snow in NYC too, but skiiing or just ice skating?
[MrFrugalSpend] Normally… but I went to Utah this year, Park City up in the mountains from Salt Lake City, but they had record low snowfall as part of the whole drought in the centre there…
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3kwWcipPn3U
Especially given it feeds their water supply, hopefully they get more over the next season.
Quite expensive at the big name resorts too
[Satchimo] In the industry, so once we get there, it's mates rates for accom, food & beverage.

[Brick50] Whataburger any good? Was in texas last month and didn't try it… Denver has In N Out at least! Seems they recently expanded as I didn't expect to see it there
[veetor] Whataburger has the same problem Carl's Jr has - has the same flavour profile as Hungry Jack's.
[andyfc] Syd to Denver has an 10 hour layover in Phoenix, after a 4 hour layover in LA….not great.
[dtpearson] We can tell. That is why they are having to subsidise flights so heavily resulting in such cheap airfares to visit the USA, so their entire tourism economy does not collapse.
[smartazz104] You must be receiving the same printouts as the orange toddler.

[Chatgpttrue] Tell us more. I haven't been to the US for over 20 years!

[slamdunka] The Grand Canyon, New York, Hollywood, and dont forget the public executions!

[drprox] I'm more commonly amazed by how presumptuous people are
[Matt88] Is that the price that they are paying people to fly there?
[kaitongvan] ICE is underperforming, needs more body count
[Insane22] After just getting back from LA & Vegas, the cost is insane… Coffee was AUD $18.50, beer was $25 and a jack and coke in a short glass was $44 at a show. Essentially a 40% conversion and add a 20% tip on everything. Go out for a lunch for one and it was AUD $150…
[nosytt] Yes I was in Vegas in 2024, never again, the food was cheaper at the airport!!!!
I did drive from San Fransisco to Vegas through Lake Tahoe, now that was worth it, but Vegas? NOPE.
[mulimulix] Vegas has gotten unbelievably expensive in the last decade but there are still a few bargains to be found, just have to do some research which I know a lot of people would rather not do. At least accommodation is still usually very cheap even after the stupid resort fees.
[Windows98] Personally I think there are more interesting third world countries to visit.
[mulimulix] The way some people on here talk about the US as the worst travel destination in the world is just absurd. There are fair criticisms to be made but calling it third world, risk of dying, etc is just exaggeration to the max. We went earlier this year and had an amazing time. The people and variety are probably the best in the world as a traveler for a single country.
